recipe.title: Banana Oat Pancakes

steps.text: Blend bananas, oats, milk, and cinnamon into batter.
Cook small pancakes in a nonstick pan.
Serve with fruit or yogurt.

substitutions: Use plant milk for a dairy-free version.
Add berries to the batter.
allergen_notes: Contains dairy unless plant milk is used. Oats may contain gluten traces.

recipe.title: Arroz A La Cubana Inspired Bowl

steps.text: Cook rice until tender.
Warm tomato sauce and white beans.
Pan-sear banana halves and serve over rice with sauce.

substitutions: Use chickpeas instead of white beans.
Add a fried protein if desired.
allergen_notes: No common allergens.

recipe.title: Beef Vegetable Noodles

steps.text: Cook noodles and drain.
Sear beef strips quickly.
Stir fry vegetables, return beef, and toss with noodles and soy sauce.

substitutions: Use chicken strips instead of beef.
Use rice for a gluten-free base.
allergen_notes: Contains soy. Noodles may contain gluten.

recipe.title: Pan Con Tomate Breakfast

steps.text: Toast the bread until crisp.
Grate tomatoes and season with olive oil and salt.
Spoon tomato over toast and serve with oranges.

substitutions: Use wholegrain bread for more fiber.
Add avocado when available.
allergen_notes: Contains gluten.

recipe.title: Falafel Wraps With Yogurt Sauce

steps.text: Warm falafel in a pan or oven.
Mix yogurt with lemon, salt, and pepper.
Fill wraps with lettuce, tomato, falafel, and sauce.

substitutions: Use hummus instead of yogurt sauce for a vegan wrap.
Serve over salad instead of wraps.
allergen_notes: Wraps contain gluten. Yogurt contains dairy.

recipe.title: Chicken Fajita Bowls

steps.text: Cook rice and warm beans.
Slice chicken and peppers, then saute with fajita spices.
Serve chicken, peppers, beans, and corn over rice.

substitutions: Use tofu for a vegetarian bowl.
Use tortillas instead of rice.
allergen_notes: Check spice mixes for gluten traces.

recipe.title: Yogurt Oat Breakfast Bowl

steps.text: Divide yogurt between bowls.
Top with oats, sliced banana, and berries.
Chill briefly or serve immediately.

substitutions: Use soy yogurt for a dairy-free bowl.
Use apple instead of berries.
allergen_notes: Contains dairy unless plant yogurt is used. Oats may contain gluten traces.

recipe.title: Gazpacho With Chickpea Toast

steps.text: Blend tomatoes, cucumber, pepper, olive oil, vinegar, and salt.
Toast bread and crush chickpeas with lemon and oil.
Serve chilled gazpacho with chickpea toast.

substitutions: Use white beans instead of chickpeas.
Skip bread for a lighter lunch.
allergen_notes: Bread contains gluten.

recipe.title: Chicken Noodle Soup

steps.text: Simmer chicken, carrot, celery, and stock.
Shred chicken and return it to the pot.
Add noodles and cook until tender.

substitutions: Use rice instead of noodles.
Use leftover roast chicken.
allergen_notes: Noodles may contain gluten. Stock may contain celery.

recipe.title: Quinoa With Roasted Vegetables

steps.text: Roast diced sweet potato and broccoli.
Cook quinoa until fluffy.
Toss quinoa with vegetables, chickpeas, lemon, and olive oil.

substitutions: Use couscous if quinoa is unavailable.
Use carrots instead of sweet potato.
allergen_notes: No common allergens.

recipe.title: Chickpea Spinach Curry

steps.text: Cook rice according to the package.
Simmer chickpeas with coconut milk and curry spice.
Fold in spinach until wilted and serve over rice.

substitutions: Use lentils instead of chickpeas.
Use frozen spinach if fresh is unavailable.
allergen_notes: Coconut is a tree nut for some allergy policies.

recipe.title: Tuna And White Bean Salad

steps.text: Drain tuna and beans.
Chop tomato, onion, and lettuce.
Toss everything with olive oil, vinegar, and salt.

substitutions: Use chickpeas instead of white beans.
Use canned salmon instead of tuna.
allergen_notes: Contains fish.

recipe.title: Cod With Spanish Pisto

steps.text: Dice vegetables and simmer with tomato sauce into pisto.
Boil or roast potatoes.
Cook cod gently on top of the pisto until flaky.

substitutions: Use hake instead of cod.
Serve with rice instead of potatoes.
allergen_notes: Contains fish.

recipe.title: Hake Rice Soup

steps.text: Simmer carrot and leek in stock.
Add rice and cook until nearly tender.
Add hake pieces and simmer gently until cooked.

substitutions: Use cod or salmon pieces.
Use vegetable stock if fish stock is unavailable.
allergen_notes: Contains fish.

recipe.title: Lentil And Vegetable Stew

steps.title: Prep vegetables
steps.text: Dice the onion, carrots, and potatoes.

steps.title: Build base
steps.text: Saute onion, then add vegetables, lentils, stock, and water.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Simmer until lentils and potatoes are tender. Adjust seasoning.

substitutions: Use chickpeas when lentils are unavailable.
Add spinach at the end for extra greens.
allergen_notes: Check stock cube labels for gluten or celery.
